text: {"lessons":["A short run of losses is a reminder that stocks can be volatile; I should assess each holding on its fundamentals and long-term prospects, not react impulsively to price declines.","Doing nothing is still a decision: I should review whether my cash and stock exposure remain appropriately diversified and suited to my risk tolerance.","I should avoid overconfidence in my professional experience and check my portfolio periodically, making deliberate changes only when the investment case or my goals have changed."]}
